scope: Diagnostic images only, not shipped firmware or release QA
before: No USB_IO handles; only one inactive SimpleTextInput and one EX console
after: Three USB_IO, three SimpleTextInput and three EX handles; R Unicode 0x72 received; Recovery opened and USB mouse clicked Terminal and Continue
cause: Optical Block I/O FV omits UhciDxe/EhciDxe/UsbBusDxe, unlike full OpenDuet. Loading XhciDxe/OpenUsbKbDxe alone cannot enumerate USB_IO interfaces.
firmware_fix: Three byte-identical FFS modules from same pinned full 1.0.8 image, BIOS Block I/O and all original 29 FFS preserved

Recovery_keyboard_followup.observed: With change-only SET_IDLE=0, actual callback trace misses key presses/releases and can leave Return repeating. Increasing automation hold alone did not resolve it.
Recovery_keyboard_followup.standard_fix: HID SET_IDLE duration 8 (32 ms), Report ID 0; unchanged reports do not generate duplicate presses; local repeat is retained. SET_IDLE STALL remains optional.
Recovery_keyboard_followup.diagnostic_causality: Same emulated topology passed menu + sw_vers after changing only SET_IDLE duration; final non-diagnostic ISO passed both mouse and tablet.
